svg.title: System architecture overview
svg.desc: C4 component view of the Dart host process: four ways work arrives, the conversation, execution and task components, policy, storage and shared services, and the sidecars and provider binaries it runs as child processes.

g.text: Hover a box for its responsibility; its connections light up. Click a box to open its document.
Inside a rendered document this image is static. Click it to open the interactive SVG.

svg.text: C4 · LEVEL 3 · COMPONENTS OF THE DART HOST
One Dart host process owns state and policy. Provider binaries only reason and run tools.
SHARED SERVICES · USED BY EVERY COMPONENT

g.text: Channel ingress · dartclaw_whatsapp, dartclaw_signal, dartclaw_google_chat, dartclaw_slack
Adapters normalise platform payloads into ChannelMessage and hand them to ChannelManager.
Web UI and REST API · DartclawServer (shelf), Trellis templates, HTMX fragments, SSE streams
POST /api/sessions/<id>/send admits chat messages through ConversationService.submit.
ScheduleService · heartbeat, git-sync and configured cron, interval and once jobs
A prompt job starts a turn through TurnManager with cron provenance; a task job creates a reviewable task.
tools for agents and MCP clients
MCP server · McpProtocolHandler on the same shelf server
Memory, knowledge, task, workflow, scheduling and web tools; guard-evaluated and audited at dispatch.
Conversation · routes inbound messages to sessions and owns session and conversation state
Pause check, thread binding, per-sender rate limit, then a debounced FIFO MessageQueue per session.
Execution · admission, then one capacity grant per execution
Budget, session lock, loop and rate checks gate a turn; TurnRunner drives the provider binary and streams its events.
Tasks and workflows · queued tasks and workflow steps
Each leases a provider worker from ExecutionCoordinator, runs in a git worktree if one is declared, then goes to review.
Storage · files are authoritative for sessions, messages, memory, config and audit
PostgreSQL 14+ holds tasks, executions, workflow runs, traces, events, knowledge-graph facts and derived search projections.
Policy · guards, rate limits, token budget, loop detection
Container isolation and host-held credentials: ContainerManager and HostGateway wrap every container execution.
Projects and worktrees · git clones under <data_dir>/projects
Per-task worktrees and push and PR creation; blocking git calls run in isolates.
memory corpus, hybrid search, temporal KG
Knowledge · canonical Markdown memory with derived PostgreSQL search projections
The temporal knowledge graph and the wiki sit beside it; agents reach all of it through MCP tools and prompt composition.
Fire-and-forget typed events, hot-reloadable configuration, alert routing and usage tracking.
GOWA · Go sidecar for the WhatsApp Web protocol
dartclaw_whatsapp drives it over REST and receives inbound messages by webhook.
dartclaw_signal drives it over JSON-RPC and reads inbound messages from its SSE stream.
claude · Claude Code CLI, bidirectional JSONL over stdin and stdout
Runs inside a container behind HostGateway, or as a host subprocess when the container posture is off.
codex · Codex app-server, JSON-RPC over stdio
Runs inside a container behind HostGateway, or as a host subprocess when the container posture is off.
ACP agent · any Agent Client Protocol agent
No mediated container boundary exists for ACP, so these agents run on the host only.
